What's your return and refund policy?
Our return window is 14 DAYS AFTER DELIVERY. Items must be in ORIGINAL CONDITION, UNWORN OR UNUSED, WITH TAGS ATTACHED, IN THE ORIGINAL PACKAGING, AND INCLUDE PROOF OF PURCHASE.
A few key policy points:
- A $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE is deducted from each refund.
- FINAL-SALE ITEMS and items returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR STAINS are STORE CREDIT ONLY.
- NON-RETURNABLE ITEMS: international orders EXCEPT CANADA, intimates, bodysuits, jewelry, all markdown/sale items, and gift cards.
- Once your return is received and inspected, the refund is sent to your ORIGINAL PAYMENT METHOD WITHIN 10 BUSINESS DAYS; if it’s been MORE THAN 14 BUSINESS DAYS since your return was received, contact NW@NAKEDWARDROBE.COM.
To start a return or exchange, please use our return portal: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
